values.note: Most sites are short: about five take a 23-ft rig - 12 and 14 (50-ft paved pull-throughs, 40-ft limit), 13 and 15 (recreation.gov permits RVs to 36-40 ft though it also lists a 15-ft vehicle limit) and double site 8 (25 ft).
